tools.name: act_until
tools.description: Repeat one action until a condition holds (walk until a prompt appears). Shorthand for one until-loop.

tools.name: anchor_mem
tools.description: Learned anchor memory for UI elements: list / learn / verify / forget / stats. Stores normalised position + a 64-bit visual fingerprint + usage counters, so a click can be verified instead of guessed.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run a whole gesture sequence in ONE call. Each step: {action:'move'|'click'|'double_click'|'right_click'|'type'|'key'|'sleep'|'wait_change'|'screen_state'|'ui_click', ...}. Use this instead of many separate calls (each separate call costs a model round trip).

tools.name: button_down
tools.description: Press and hold a mouse button

tools.name: button_up
tools.description: Release a mouse button

tools.name: capture_config
tools.description: Get or set capture settings: scale (default 0.5 -> 1280x720), quality (75), format (jpeg|png), diff_threshold (0.8 %), mask_bottom (60 px of taskbar ignored by change detection). Call with no args to just read them.

diff_threshold.description: Mean abs diff % that counts as changed

mask_bottom.description: Bottom pixel rows ignored by change detection

tools.name: capture_daemon
tools.description: Start/stop/status of the persistent screen-capture daemon (ring buffer, default scale 0.25, 12 fps active / 3 fps idle). After start, sense/watch/probe read memory instead of grabbing the screen.

tools.name: capture_template
tools.description: Save a screen region as a reusable template (grayscale PNG) under the tool's vision store. Use this for self-drawn UIs where UI Automation is blind: capture the button/icon once, then match_template finds it later. Give a tight region around the visual itself.

hwnd.description: Optional: grab the window bitmap (works when covered)

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click. Without coordinates it clicks the current cursor. With frame_id and x/y, x/y are IMAGE coordinates of that screenshot and the server converts them to physical pixels - prefer this. Without frame_id, x/y are physical screen pixels and are converted after rechecking the target process.

frame_id.description: Screenshot frame_id; x/y are then image coordinates of that frame

tools.name: click_template
tools.description: Find a template and click its centre. No coordinate guessing. Optional offset [dx,dy] nudges the click point.

tools.name: click_text
tools.description: Find a string with OCR and click it, in ONE call. The reliable way to click inside apps whose controls UIA cannot see (WeChat, Electron, custom-rendered UIs).

hwnd.description: Raise this window first, then OCR its rectangle

tools.name: close_window
tools.description: Close a window

tools.name: control_claim
tools.description: 申请或交还桌面控制权（action=claim|release）。用户物理动鼠标会自动夺回

tools.name: control_status
tools.description: Read control ownership and actual-caller authorization_diagnostic. Optional hwnd and requested_scopes report target and missing capabilities; this does not grant permissions.

tools.name: dataset_explore
tools.description: 随机游走采集弱语义轨迹（只调用只读工具，不点击不输入），样本打 explore 标签

tools.name: dataset_export
tools.description: 把最近 N 天的样本打包成 zip（离线回流/微调用），默认 7 天

tools.name: dataset_promote
tools.description: 把某条样本提升为回归用例（写 dataset/cases/，供反复验证）

episode_id.description: 样本 id（dataset_query 里能看到）

note.description: 备注：为什么这条值得回归

tools.name: dataset_query
tools.description: 按工具/分区/结果/天数筛训练样本（只读，默认返回最新 20 条）

tools.name: dataset_status
tools.description: 训练数据分区状态：是否开启、今日/累计样本数、占用体积、最近一条样本

tools.name: dataset_triage
tools.description: 分拣失败样本：同类失败达到阈值就自动生成回归用例（默认 1 天 / 3 次）

tools.name: diff_baseline
tools.description: Compare a region against its stored baseline. Returns diff (mean abs difference 0-255) and changed = diff >= threshold.

tools.name: double_click
tools.description: Double-click. With frame_id and x/y, x/y are IMAGE coordinates of that screenshot and the server converts them; without coordinates it double-clicks at the current cursor.

frame_id.description: Screenshot frame_id; x/y are then image coordinates of that frame

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag from start to end. Each point is {"x","y"}; with frame_id both are IMAGE coordinates of that screenshot and the server converts them.

frame_id.description: Screenshot frame_id; start/end are then image coordinates

button.description: Mouse button to use for drag

tools.name: element_action
tools.description: 按控件自身能力执行动作（invoke / set_value / toggle / select / click），可选回读校验

verify.description: 动作后回读状态，判断是否真的生效

tools.name: element_state
tools.description: 读取控件真实状态（启用/可见/聚焦/选中/值/勾选），不用截图猜

ref.description: 来自 find_element/find_elements_ranked/ui_tree 的 element ref

name.description: 没有 ref 时按控件名定位

tools.name: execute_verified
tools.description: 一次调用完成：定位 → 执行 → 等到后置条件成立 → 报告是否真的生效

tools.name: find_element
tools.description: 统一寻址：依次尝试 UIA / OCR / 模板，返回元素的屏幕坐标（自绘界面也能用）

query.description: 控件名（UIA）或文字（OCR）或模板名（template）

tools.name: find_elements_ranked
tools.description: 多来源融合定位：一次比较 UIA / OCR / 模板候选，返回排序结果、来源、置信度与歧义标记

query.description: 控件名（UIA）或文字（OCR）或模板名

include_state.description: 为每个 UIA 候选附带 enabled/value/toggle 等状态（略慢）

tools.name: find_text
tools.description: OCR the screen (or a region) and find a string, tolerating OCR mistakes: whitespace between CJK glyphs is ignored and a single mis-read character still matches. Returns centre coordinates.

hwnd.description: Raise this window first, then OCR its rectangle

tools.name: frame_diff
tools.description: Compare two buffered frames by index in an optional region: mean abs diff and changed flag.

tools.name: frame_mark
tools.description: Mark a frame index by name, used with frame_diff to verify an action took effect.

tools.name: get_window_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a window

tools.name: glyph
tools.description: Manage learned digit glyphs for pixel fonts. action=list|learn|clear; learn needs label and box.

tools.name: housekeeping
tools.description: Show disk usage of this tool's own folders (_draw / recordings / vision baselines) and optionally prune them. Assets (macros, recipes, templates, _patched) are never touched. action=status (default, read-only) or sweep (with dry_run).

tools.name: hover_probe
tools.description: Hover a point, wait, measure whether a region changed, then move the cursor away. This detects hover-revealed menus/buttons that never show up in a plain screenshot or a click.

tools.name: hud
tools.description: Auto-locate HUD text rows by color (cyan/yellow/...) and return their screen boxes. Survives window resize/move; optional per-color rows list. Feed the boxes to read_digits or probe.

box.description: search area in screen coords, default whole screen

tools.name: key_down
tools.description: Press and hold a key

tools.name: key_press
tools.description: Press and release a key (convenience method)

tools.name: key_up
tools.description: Release a key

tools.name: layout_mem
tools.description: Layout calibration memory (generic): save normalized regions once per app, then resolve to pixels at any window size. action=save needs hwnd+regions{name:[x,y,w,h] rel 0..1}; action=resolve returns pixel boxes; list/delete manage profiles.

tools.name: list_virtual_desktops
tools.description: List all virtual desktops with their IDs and names

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List all visible windows with their handles, titles, processes, and bounds

tools.name: macro_list
tools.description: List saved macros (name, description, target window, step count).

tools.name: macro_run
tools.description: Replay a saved macro in ONE call. Coordinates are re-based onto the target window's current position. Use dry_run=true to see resolved absolute coordinates without clicking.

tools.name: macro_save
tools.description: Save a macro. Steps use window-relative 'rel':[dx,dy] coordinates and can carry 'expect':{'changed':true,'timeout_ms':1200} to verify the step actually did something.

tools.name: match_template
tools.description: Find a stored template on screen (grayscale template matching). Returns found/score and the ABSOLUTE screen x,y,w,h and center. No OCR, no UIA - works on games, Electron and CEF windows.

tools.name: maximize_window
tools.description: Maximize a window

tools.name: minimize_window
tools.description: Minimize a window

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates

tools.name: move_window
tools.description: Move and/or resize a window to specified position and size

width.description: Window width (optional, preserves current if not specified)

height.description: Window height (optional, preserves current if not specified)

tools.name: move_window_to_virtual_desktop
tools.description: Move a window to a different virtual desktop

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: M3: run a plan locally at 20+ Hz and come back only on success or stall. plan=[{kind:goto,cell:[c,r]}|{kind:search}|{kind:face,cell}|{kind:wait,ms}|{kind:key,key}]. Returns a short state page, so one call can cover a whole objective.

tools.name: ocr_read
tools.description: Read text off the screen with the Windows OCR engine and return the recognised lines with boxes. Text only - much cheaper than sending an image when all you need is what the UI says. Pass a region to scan just one window.

hwnd.description: Raise this window first, then OCR its rectangle

regions.description: 一次 OCR 多块区域（每块 {x,y,w,h}），省往返

tools.name: probe
tools.description: One pixel primitive on the cached frame (1-3 ms): prompt (bright text present), bar (colored bar fill), openness (view open), color (blob), digits (number).

tools.name: read_digits
tools.description: Read a digit string from a region of the cached frame with 5x7 template matching (1-3 ms). Works on pixel fonts that defeat OCR.

tools.name: record
tools.description: Dump the daemon ring buffer (frames + manifest + last trace) to disk for evidence or replay.

tools.name: resize_window
tools.description: Resize a window to specified dimensions

tools.name: restore_window
tools.description: Restore a minimized or maximized window to normal state

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Execute a micro-script locally in ONE call (closed loop): ops = key/press/turn/move/click/scroll/sleep/loop/if/until/log. A 40-step navigation loop costs one round trip. Returns a trace.

tools.name: sample_stable
tools.description: Sample a region several times and report whether it is stable (all hashes equal). Use it before trusting a state reading: this is how you avoid judging a UI while an animation is still running.

tools.name: screen_layout
tools.description: Generic layout detection for ANY window (no app-specific constants): content box (letterbox-aware), HUD text rows, lattice panels (minimaps/radars/boards) via periodicity, and progress bars with fill ratio. Returns pixel boxes plus normalized rel coords.

tools.name: screen_state
tools.description: Cheap screen check WITHOUT returning an image (~40 ms). Reports whether the screen changed since the last capture, by how much (mean abs diff %), and a short hash. Use this to poll instead of screenshot.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the display (or one/more regions of it) and return it as base64-encoded PNG

regions.description: 一次截多块，每块返回一张图（省往返）

tools.name: screenshot_window
tools.description: Capture screenshot of a specific window

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll at the current pointer or optional screen x/y. dy>0 up, dy<0 down; dx>0 right. Integer wheel steps limited to [-100,100] per axis. Rechecks target process before injection; content movement remains unverified.

tools.name: sense
tools.description: Return what changed since a frame index plus requested primitives (prompt/bar/openness/color/digits). Reads the daemon buffer; typically under 10 ms and transfers no image.

tools.name: servo
tools.description: M2: closed-loop servo toward a map cell. op=calibrate (estimate heading by stepping and watching the minimap displacement) | face | approach | forward | turn. Recomputes bearing every step instead of walking blind.

tools.name: set_baseline
tools.description: Remember what a screen region normally looks like. diff_baseline later reports how far the current pixels deviate - precise and cheap, and scoped to just that region.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Configure observation options

observe_mouse_button_states.description: Track and include mouse button states

observe_keyboard_key_states.description: Track and include keyboard key states

disallowed_hotkeys.description: List of hotkey strings to disallow (e.g., ['ctrl+c', 'alt+f4'])

constrain_mouse_to_window.description: Constrain mouse movement and clicks to window bounds. Set to window handle (int), window title pattern (str), or null to disable.

observe_system_metrics.description: Track and include system performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk I/O, network I/O)

tools.name: set_window_topmost
tools.description: Set or remove a window's always-on-top property

topmost.description: Whether window should be always on top

tools.name: snap_window_bottom
tools.description: Snap window to fill bottom half of screen

tools.name: snap_window_left
tools.description: Snap window to fill left half of screen

tools.name: snap_window_right
tools.description: Snap window to fill right half of screen

tools.name: snap_window_top
tools.description: Snap window to fill top half of screen

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Grab one image on demand and return its file path (no base64). Use only when pixels must be inspected.

tools.name: switch_to_window
tools.description: Switch focus to a window by handle or title pattern

title.description: Window title pattern to search for (alternative to hwnd)

tools.name: switch_virtual_desktop
tools.description: Switch to a virtual desktop by ID or name

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Return the trace of the last run_script, or the run history.

tools.name: track
tools.description: 列车：三轮回转（入帧 30fps / 处理差分状态机 / 输出摘要+拼图）+ 看门狗。action=start 后列车常驻后台跑，随时用 status 取新鲜摘要（含一张拼图路径）；action=run 阻塞跑到结束；stop 停车；selfcheck 短跑报 fps/内存。track={'name':..,'window':{'process':..},'steps':[{name,expect,action,budget_ms}]}

tools.name: triple_click
tools.description: Perform a triple mouse click at the current cursor position

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type the specified text

tools.name: type_verified
tools.description: 输入文本并回读目标控件，判断字符是否真的进去了（丢字/焦点错位会被发现）

ref.description: 目标输入框的 element ref（可选）

name.description: 没给 ref 时按控件名定位输入框

tools.name: ui_click
tools.description: Move the real cursor to a control found by name and click it. No coordinate guessing.

tools.name: ui_find
tools.description: Find controls by accessible name (substring, or exact=true). Returns candidates with their centre coordinates. Cheaper and more reliable than reading a screenshot.

tools.name: ui_invoke
tools.description: Trigger a control by name through its Invoke pattern, without moving the cursor (fastest, non-intrusive). Falls back with a hint if the control has no Invoke.

tools.name: ui_set_text
tools.description: Set a text field's value through its Value pattern, without typing keystrokes.

tools.name: ui_tree
tools.description: Compact UI-Automation control tree for a window (or the focused one). Text only, no screenshot: control type + name + rect. Use it to find what is clickable before clicking.

tools.name: verify_flow
tools.description: Run staged verification and return per-stage evidence. Each stage may wait, then run assertions: kind=text|template|baseline|stable|file. Stages stop at the first failure (stop_on_fail) and the report can be written to a JSON file. Verification only - it performs no input actions.

tools.name: vision_list
tools.description: List stored templates and baselines (name, source region, size, creation time), plus live run statistics: calls, failures, retries, failure_rate. Use stats to spot a long automation that silently stopped working.

tools.name: wait_baseline_change
tools.description: Block until a region deviates from its baseline by more than threshold, or until timeout.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: 统一等待入口：等屏幕变化/文字出现/模板出现/元素出现/窗口聚焦（单次调用内轮询）

query.description: text 时是要找的文字；template 时是模板名

element_id.description: element 时按 ui_tree 的 id 等

any.description: 多个条件，任一满足即返回（kind/query/element_id 的数组）

tools.name: wait_for_change
tools.description: Block until the screen changes above the threshold, or until timeout. Cheaper than the model polling screen_state in a loop.

tools.name: wait_template
tools.description: Block until a template appears (appear=true) or disappears (appear=false), or until timeout. Event driven and cheaper than polling match_template from the model.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Block until a condition holds (event-driven wait, replaces sleep+re-screenshot polling). Kinds: prompt/bar/openness/color/digits/diff.

tools.name: world_state
tools.description: M1: compress the screen into structured state — minimap grid (auto-calibrated pitch), player cell, objective markers, prompt flag, battery. Returns a short text page you can read instead of an image. Needs map_region=[x,y,w,h] in screen coords.
